title: No phone after 9 p.m.: one week in
excerpt: An experiment in boredom. I read more, slept better, and missed nothing that mattered.
body:
For one week I put my phone on the shelf at 9 p.m. and didn't pick it up again until morning.

The first two evenings were strange. I kept reaching for a phone that wasn't there. By the third I'd finished half a book.

What I noticed: I slept earlier, woke up less tired, and missed nothing that couldn't wait until the morning. I'm keeping it, most nights.
